notes.title: BIG DAY Release Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31452004/ecc547b0c56f2c750330547e2c395d012b28cdc8.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,
 
As you know, we had scheduled the release of BIG DAY for today, 25th September. 
To meet this launch day, we submitted the release build for Steam review on 19th September. This process normally takes just a few days; however Steam have not yet completed their review. 
 
Unfortunately, this means we are unable to release BIG DAY today.
 
The game is in the review process now, and we will update you as soon as possible once we are given the green light to release. Apologies to all those looking forward to blasting zombies today – we know it sucks.
